slots.claim_sentence: Many decisions arise from the accumulation of noisy evidence until a threshold is reached.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process continues until the evidence for one choice hits a specific limit.

slots.claim_sentence: Decision models aim to explain the choice made, the speed, and the confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: Stronger signals usually lead to faster and more accurate choices in these models.

slots.claim_sentence: The model paradoxically predicts that increased noise leads to faster decisions and higher confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: Noise causes the evidence to reach the decision boundary more quickly than usual.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used a sensory manipulation to mimic noise in the visual cortex.
slots.clarification_sentence: They verified this method using neuronal recordings from macaque areas MT and MST.

slots.claim_sentence: In humans and monkeys, increasing noise induced faster decisions and greater confidence.
slots.clarification_sentence: This effect occurred even when the accuracy of the choices was minimally impaired.

slots.claim_sentence: The magnitude of these effects showed agreement with predictions of the accumulation model.
slots.clarification_sentence: A single mechanism explains the results across different species and decision tasks.

slots.claim_sentence: The increase in confidence was most noticeable when the motion signals were weakest.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers observed these patterns in both species during the visual tasks.

slots.claim_sentence: Greater volatility makes the evidence diffuse more quickly away from the starting point.
slots.clarification_sentence: This rapid movement explains why noisy signals can trigger a faster response.

slots.claim_sentence: The bacterium Shigella flexneri releases an enzyme called OspI into host cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Shigella flexneri causes severe diarrhea by invading the intestine and hiding from the immune system.

slots.claim_sentence: OspI changes a specific part of the host protein UBC13 into glutamate.
slots.clarification_sentence: OspI specifically targets a glutamine residue in UBC13 and converts it to glutamate.

slots.claim_sentence: This chemical change silences the host NF-κB inflammatory response.
slots.clarification_sentence: The modification prevents the UBC13 and TRAF6 proteins from working together.

slots.claim_sentence: The modification inhibits the interaction between UBC13 and the TRAF6 RING-domain.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change disrupts both native and transient contacts between the two proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: A new intramolecular salt-bridge forms within the modified UBC13 protein.
slots.clarification_sentence: This internal bridge competes with the intermolecular bridge needed for TRAF6 binding.

slots.claim_sentence: Repulsion occurs between the negatively charged E100 and the TRAF6 surface.
slots.clarification_sentence: This electrical repulsion prevents the proteins from forming necessary temporary connections.

slots.claim_sentence: Post-translational modifications can control how proteins associate by destabilizing transient contacts.
slots.clarification_sentence: The study shows how subtle chemical changes effectively block immune signaling.

slots.claim_sentence: Understanding these tiny chemical changes explains how bacteria disable the human immune system.
slots.clarification_sentence: The pathogen employs salt-bridge competition to produce a remarkable cumulative effect.

slots.claim_sentence: Rhythmic brain waves in the theta frequency coordinate activity across distant brain regions during memory tasks.
slots.clarification_sentence: These waves occur at 4–8 Hz to help different parts of the brain work together.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used tACS to sync brain waves in the right frontoparietal network.
slots.clarification_sentence: The 6 Hz stimulation targeted the middle frontal gyrus and inferior parietal lobule.

slots.claim_sentence: Synchronous stimulation improved reaction times during high-demand memory tasks.
slots.clarification_sentence: This effect made performance on the difficult 2-back task similar to the easier 1-back task.

slots.claim_sentence: Simultaneous fMRI scans showed that stimulation effects depend on the current cognitive state.
slots.clarification_sentence: The scans allowed researchers to watch how the brain responded to stimulation in real-time.

slots.claim_sentence: Synchronized stimulation increased parietal activity which correlated with faster responses.
slots.clarification_sentence: The parietal lobe is a key region for holding information during verbal memory tasks.

slots.claim_sentence: The stimulation changed how information flow occurs between frontal and parietal regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Syncing these areas through functional connectivity enhanced their ability to communicate.

slots.claim_sentence: The study demonstrates a causal link between large-scale brain synchronization and cognition.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests that external stimulation could help conditions that slow down internal brain communication.

slots.claim_sentence: Stimulation was applied as a sinusoidal wave with a peak-to-peak amplitude of 1000 μA.
slots.clarification_sentence: The researchers used this specific electrical current to exogenously modulate oscillatory activity.

slots.claim_sentence: The granular retrosplenial cortex is essential for navigation and memory.
slots.clarification_sentence: This brain region, known as the RSG, handles spatial and non-spatial behaviors.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used optogenetic circuit mapping in mice to study this region.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method uses light to control and map specific brain circuits.

slots.claim_sentence: The anterior thalamus sends spatial information to low-rheobase cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The dorsal subiculum also provides spatial data to these specialized neurons.

slots.claim_sentence: Regular-spiking cells receive non-spatial inputs from the claustrum and cingulate.
slots.clarification_sentence: These RS cells focus on different signals than their LR neighbors.

slots.claim_sentence: Parallel processing occurs through precise physical overlap in layer 1.
slots.clarification_sentence: Specific axons and dendrites meet in organized sub-layers to keep signals separate.

slots.claim_sentence: LR neurons calculate the speed of head rotation from direction signals.
slots.clarification_sentence: Synaptic dynamics allow these cells to act like a biological gyroscope.

slots.claim_sentence: This distinct neuronal subtype supports complex spatial orientation in the brain.
slots.clarification_sentence: The discovery explains how the RSG processes information for navigation.

slots.claim_sentence: Low-rheobase cells are unique among the pyramidal cells in the RSG.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specialized neurons are highly excitable and handle spatial data.

slots.claim_sentence: Thalamic inputs allow for the robust encoding of angular speed.
slots.clarification_sentence: The neurons compute rotation speed even without explicit speed signals.

slots.claim_sentence: Consistent flower shapes are important for reproductive success and are robust to environmental changes.
slots.clarification_sentence: A trait is robust when it stays the same despite environmental or genetic changes.

slots.claim_sentence: The research plant Arabidopsis thaliana consistently produces flowers with exactly four petals.
slots.clarification_sentence: This consistency makes Arabidopsis a model for studying how plants maintain stable traits.

slots.claim_sentence: In the related species Cardamine hirsuta, the number of petals varies between zero and four.
slots.clarification_sentence: Unlike Arabidopsis, this species lacks the robustness to keep a fixed petal count.

slots.claim_sentence: Differences in a regulator gene called APETALA1 are responsible for these species differences.
slots.clarification_sentence: The AP1 regulator initiates flower development and specifies the formation of floral organs.

slots.claim_sentence: The Arabidopsis version of AP1 works by masking the effects of other genetic variations.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers used quantitative trait loci analysis to find these hidden genetic regions.

slots.claim_sentence: The Cardamine version of AP1 fails to stabilize petals due to changes in regulatory regions.
slots.clarification_sentence: These regulatory regions act like switches rather than changing the protein coding regions.

slots.claim_sentence: Cardamine maintains a variable petal number despite having genetic variation for four-petalled flowers.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests that the standing genetic variation is maintained in natural populations.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists do not yet fully understand how digestive organs undergo regeneration.
slots.clarification_sentence: Regeneration is the process where an animal regrows lost or damaged body parts.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied Schmidtea mediterranea, a planarian flatworm that can regenerate its entire gut.
slots.clarification_sentence: The team used laser-capture microdissection, or LCM, to isolate specific intestinal tissues.

slots.claim_sentence: This sensitive method identified 809 transcripts that previous single-cell studies did not find.
slots.clarification_sentence: Transcripts are copies of genetic instructions used by cells to build proteins.

slots.claim_sentence: The planarian intestine shows high similarity to human tissues like the liver and duodenum.
slots.clarification_sentence: These similarities involve genes used for metabolism and the digestion of food.

slots.claim_sentence: The study revealed regionalization of gene expression in the middle and side areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: Specific goblet cells were restricted to either the medial or lateral intestinal regions.

slots.claim_sentence: The transcription factors gli-1 and RREB2 control these specialized goblet cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: The gli-1 factor regulates regeneration while RREB2 ensures the maintenance of these cells.

slots.claim_sentence: This intestinal map serves as a foundational resource for studying organ healing.
slots.clarification_sentence: The data may help researchers understand human gastrointestinal pathologies in the future.

slots.claim_sentence: The researchers combined LCM with RNA-seq to characterize the intestinal transcriptome.
slots.clarification_sentence: A transcriptome is the complete set of all RNA molecules in a cell.

slots.claim_sentence: Planarian cells demonstrate functional homology with the digestive systems of other animals.
slots.clarification_sentence: Functional homology means the cells perform similar tasks across different species.

slots.claim_sentence: Mitochondria need quality control mechanisms to remove misfolded proteins and maintain essential functions.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mitochondrial proteins are susceptible to damage and misfolding that can cause organelle dysfunction.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used temperature-sensitive proteins in yeast to study this mitochondrial quality control.
slots.clarification_sentence: These proteins unravel when the temperature increases from 25°C to 37°C in Saccharomyces cerevisiae.

slots.claim_sentence: Misfolded proteins are degraded from the mitochondrial outer membrane by the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
slots.clarification_sentence: This degradation occurs directly at the mitochondrial surface rather than transporting proteins elsewhere.

slots.claim_sentence: Specific ubiquitin ligase enzymes called Ubr1 and San1 tag the proteins for destruction.
slots.clarification_sentence: These ligases recognize misfolded proteins on the mitochondria to trigger the clean-up operation.

slots.claim_sentence: This process requires the SSA family of Hsp70 chaperones and the Hsp40 chaperone Sis1.
slots.clarification_sentence: These helper proteins recognize misfolded shapes and target them to the cellular disposal system.

slots.claim_sentence: The Cdc48-Npl4-Ufd1 complex and the adaptor Ubx2 also facilitate protein removal.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Cdc48 complex helps the proteasome efficiently degrade the tagged proteins from the membrane.

slots.claim_sentence: This mitochondrial quality control pathway is unique and distinct from other cellular pathways.
slots.clarification_sentence: The pathway uses a specific combination of cytosolic and mitochondrial factors to protect the organelle.

slots.claim_sentence: MicroRNAs are small RNA molecules that act as regulators of gene expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: The specific molecule miR-9 is highly abundant in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: These molecules are found in both neurons and astrocytes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neurons and astrocytes are the primary cell types in the brain.

slots.claim_sentence: The impact of miR-9 on dendritic and synaptic development was previously unclear.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dendrites are tree-like structures that neurons use to connect and communicate.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers created a new transgenic sponge mouse model to study this.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model allows for the inactivation of miR-9 in specific brain regions.

slots.claim_sentence: The sponge works by binding to miR-9 to stop its normal function.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method allows scientists to control when the molecule is turned off.

slots.claim_sentence: Inhibiting miR-9 in the brain leads to shorter and less complex dendrites.
slots.clarification_sentence: This change also causes impaired synaptic transmission between the brain cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Neurons in the hippocampus showed a reduction in total dendritic length.
slots.clarification_sentence: The hippocampus is a brain region that is vital for memory.

slots.claim_sentence: The molecule miR-9 promotes dendritic growth by lowering levels of REST.
slots.clarification_sentence: REST is a transcriptional repressor that acts as a genetic switch.

slots.claim_sentence: When miR-9 is inhibited, REST levels rise and block development.
slots.clarification_sentence: The downregulation of REST is essential for proper dendritic growth.

slots.claim_sentence: Low and high temperatures limit the spread of diseases carried by mosquitoes.
slots.clarification_sentence: Extreme heat or cold reduces mosquito fecundity and their overall survival rates.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers built a mechanistic model for Ross River virus in Australia.
slots.clarification_sentence: This virus is a major pathogen in Australia and the Pacific Islands.

slots.claim_sentence: Virus transmission peaks when the environment reaches moderate temperatures of 26.4°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: The spread of the virus is most efficient at this specific temperature.

slots.claim_sentence: Transmission declines to zero at thermal limits of 17.0°C and 31.5°C.
slots.clarification_sentence: Mosquito density constraints at these limits stop the disease from spreading.

slots.claim_sentence: The virus spreads year-round in the tropics but is seasonal in temperate areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: Cold winter temperatures in southern regions stop the virus for part of the year.

slots.claim_sentence: Climate warming will likely increase transmission in temperate areas but decrease it in tropical areas.
slots.clarification_sentence: Tropical areas may become too hot for the mosquitoes to survive and spread the virus.

slots.claim_sentence: Nonlinear models are essential for predicting disease dynamics and responses to climate change.

slots.claim_sentence: The motor cortex produces brain waves called beta oscillations at 25–40 Hz.
slots.clarification_sentence: Scientists do not yet fully understand how these brain waves affect physical behavior.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used electrode arrays to record brain activity in three macaque monkeys.
slots.clarification_sentence: The monkeys used neurofeedback to control their own brain waves during the study.

slots.claim_sentence: The monkeys performed an arm reach after changing their beta oscillation levels.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers measured movement onset times to see how brain waves affected reach speed.

slots.claim_sentence: Reaches were faster when the monkeys first reduced their beta oscillation power.
slots.clarification_sentence: High beta power caused the monkeys to have slower movement onset times.

slots.claim_sentence: High beta activity shifts population neural activity farther from a movement onset state.
slots.clarification_sentence: This shift makes the brain less ready to start a physical action.

slots.claim_sentence: Beta oscillations create a low-risk state that prevents accidental body movements.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pausing state ensures safety but reduces readiness for upcoming movements.

slots.claim_sentence: The pausing state explains why high beta activity slows down movement initiation.
slots.clarification_sentence: Neural populations avoid creating patterns that cause movement during these oscillations.

slots.claim_sentence: Macaque monkeys modulated local field potential signals to move a cursor on a screen.
slots.clarification_sentence: Chronic microwire electrode arrays captured these signals from the motor cortex.

slots.claim_sentence: Some viruses like Marburg and Dengue benefit from the protein Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: Nrf2 is a protein that normally turns on genes to protect cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane is a natural product in cruciferous vegetables that activates Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: This compound is produced in vegetables like broccoli when they are damaged.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane blocks HIV infection in primary macrophages but not in T cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Macrophages and T cells are both immune cells that HIV typically infects.

slots.claim_sentence: The depletion of Nrf2 causes a significant increase in HIV infectivity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Macrophages express enough Nrf2 to partially restrict the virus without treatment.

slots.claim_sentence: The anti-viral effects of sulforaphane are mediated through the activation of Nrf2.
slots.clarification_sentence: This confirms the compound works by triggering the cell's own defense system.

slots.claim_sentence: Sulforaphane blocks infection after entry but before formation of 2-LTR circles.
slots.clarification_sentence: The virus enters the cell but cannot finish preparing its genetic material.

slots.claim_sentence: Known anti-viral proteins SAMHD1 and MX2 were not upregulated by sulforaphane.
slots.clarification_sentence: This suggests that Nrf2 uses a new pathway to stop the virus.

slots.claim_sentence: Activating Nrf2 is a novel way to block HIV infection.
slots.clarification_sentence: While some viruses hijack Nrf2, HIV is actually hindered by its activation.

slots.claim_sentence: Aedes-borne arboviruses like dengue and Zika cause increasing illness and death worldwide.
slots.clarification_sentence: Arboviruses are viruses spread to people by the bite of infected mosquitoes.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers studied transmission drivers in the Dominican Republic after a large dengue epidemic.
slots.clarification_sentence: The Zika outbreak followed the dengue epidemic, allowing for a direct comparison.

slots.claim_sentence: About 75% of dengue cases occurred in people under age 20.
slots.clarification_sentence: Zika cases were more dispersed, with only 42% occurring in that age group.

slots.claim_sentence: Zika infections were highly clustered among females, who made up 73.8% of cases.
slots.clarification_sentence: This percentage represents the majority of reported infections during the study period.

slots.claim_sentence: Guillain-Barre syndrome rates were slightly higher in males at 0.62 per 10,000 people.
slots.clarification_sentence: GBS is a neurological condition that can occur after a viral infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Existing dengue immunity had little impact on Zika rates at the population level.
slots.clarification_sentence: Prior exposure to dengue did not significantly change the risk of Zika.

slots.claim_sentence: Awareness campaigns likely drove health-seeking behaviour among women of reproductive age.
slots.clarification_sentence: These campaigns encouraged women to visit doctors more often during the outbreak.

slots.claim_sentence: Media campaigns and screening are recommended for women during future Zika outbreaks.
slots.clarification_sentence: These tools help identify cases and manage health risks in the community.

slots.claim_sentence: Anabaena filaments develop nitrogen-fixing heterocysts when they face nitrogen deprivation.
slots.clarification_sentence: These specialized cells appear in a pattern separated by ten photosynthetic cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used hetR-gfp fluorescence to track the HetR protein in individual cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: HetR is a transcription factor that is essential for making heterocysts.

slots.claim_sentence: Fluctuations in hetR expression are coupled across two to three nearby cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This coupling sets the scale for how cells interact along the filament.

slots.claim_sentence: These correlations arise from intercellular molecular transfer rather than cell division.
slots.clarification_sentence: Molecules moving between cells create stronger links than inheriting traits from parents.

slots.claim_sentence: Changes after nitrogen loss build up on fluctuations from nitrogen-replete conditions.
slots.clarification_sentence: The cells already have a baseline of activity before they face starvation.

slots.claim_sentence: The proteins PatS and SepJ determine the distribution of hetR expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: Positive HetR auto-regulation also helps control how these gene levels spread.

slots.claim_sentence: Organisms use cell-cell communication to control stochastic noise in gene expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process manages random gene activity to create a precise developmental pattern.

slots.claim_sentence: Anabaena is a multicellular cyanobacterium that forms long chains of cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: These chains are also known as filaments.

slots.claim_sentence: PatS acts as an inhibitor to slow down gene activity.
slots.clarification_sentence: The protein SepJ helps with the communication between cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Humans can learn and store multiple visuomotor mappings through a process called dual-adaptation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process allows people to adjust movements based on different environmental contexts.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants performed a pointing task on a tablet with manipulated visual feedback.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers changed the feedback location to simulate different movement requirements.

slots.claim_sentence: The target shapes were morphed along a scale between spiky and circular shapes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These shapes served as cues for which movement adjustment was needed.

slots.claim_sentence: A Bayesian learning model called a Mixture-of-Kalman-Filters describes this learning process.
slots.clarification_sentence: This model combines new sensory information with prior experiences in an optimal way.

slots.claim_sentence: Participants apply the mapping for the trained shape most similar to the current one.
slots.clarification_sentence: Learning only occurred when participants had conscious awareness of the shape's role.

slots.claim_sentence: The speed of learning will slow down as the number of training pairs increases.
slots.clarification_sentence: Learning was harder with five training pairs than with only two pairs.

slots.claim_sentence: The Bayesian model provides a mechanism for learning multiple visuomotor mappings simultaneously.
slots.clarification_sentence: The model suggests humans learn specific associations rather than a general rule.

slots.claim_sentence: Experimental results showed that participants apply the mapping corresponding to the most similar trained shape.
slots.clarification_sentence: Only those participants who consciously noticed the role of the shape learned the task.

slots.claim_sentence: Many countries lack baseline data needed for planning disease elimination programs.
slots.clarification_sentence: This missing data prevents the launch of important health advocacy efforts.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed the Integrated Threshold Mapping methodology to map four diseases.
slots.clarification_sentence: The ITM tool tracks trachoma, schistosomiasis, lymphatic filariasis, and soil-transmitted helminths.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology determines if a threshold for public health interventions is reached.
slots.clarification_sentence: Countries must pass this threshold before starting mass drug administration.

slots.claim_sentence: The protocol was field-tested in districts within Mali and Senegal.
slots.clarification_sentence: Researchers compared the new protocol against standard WHO mapping methodologies.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology reached the same conclusions as WHO for most diseases.
slots.clarification_sentence: The new tool provided more targeted recommendations for schistosomiasis at the sub-district level.

slots.claim_sentence: The ITM methodology resulted in a 31% cost savings in Mali.
slots.clarification_sentence: The integrated approach also achieved a 19% cost savings in Senegal.

slots.claim_sentence: This integrated mapping tool could facilitate program implementation in endemic countries.
slots.clarification_sentence: The tool sets the stage for integrated program activities essential for disease elimination.

slots.claim_sentence: The integrated approach proved more efficient in transport and time in the field.
slots.clarification_sentence: The methodology also improved the use of human resources during mapping.

slots.claim_sentence: Organ aging is associated with reduced stem cell occupancy in the niche.
slots.clarification_sentence: The stem cell niche is a specialized environment that houses these cells.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling increases with age in Drosophila female germline stem cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: This increase in signaling results in the removal of cells from the niche.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling regulates stem cell adhesiveness to the niche through E-cadherin expression.
slots.clarification_sentence: E-cadherin is a protein that helps cells stick to their environment.

slots.claim_sentence: The age-dependent loss of these stem cells is partially mediated by Sex lethal.
slots.clarification_sentence: Sex lethal is a gene that helps control the Notch pathway.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch activation in the niche itself is reduced as the organism ages.
slots.clarification_sentence: This reduction in the niche environment also contributes to stem cell loss.

slots.claim_sentence: These findings on Notch and cell adhesion may be relevant to metastatic cancer cells.
slots.clarification_sentence: Metastatic cancer cells often spread by suppressing their ability to stick to surfaces.

slots.claim_sentence: Stem cells with low levels of Notch signaling exhibit increased adhesiveness.
slots.clarification_sentence: Low signaling levels allow the cells to remain anchored within the niche.

slots.claim_sentence: Notch signaling in the niche cells controls the integrity of the environment.
slots.clarification_sentence: Decreased signaling in these cells reduces the overall integrity of the niche.

slots.claim_sentence: HIV infection cannot be cured but is managed with anti-retroviral drugs.
slots.clarification_sentence: Doctors use a combination treatment of several drugs to control the virus.

slots.claim_sentence: Computational models help select personalized drug combinations for each patient.
slots.clarification_sentence: These models use viral genotypes to find the most effective treatment.

slots.claim_sentence: Older models only use sequence data and ignore chemical similarity.
slots.clarification_sentence: Ignoring how drugs are chemically similar can limit prediction accuracy.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers developed proteochemometric models that include chemical and protein properties.
slots.clarification_sentence: This PCM method links drug data to specific viral variants.

slots.claim_sentence: The study used 300,000 data points across three major drug classes.
slots.clarification_sentence: These classes include PIs, NRTIs, and NNRTIs used in HIV therapy.

slots.claim_sentence: The PCM approach outperforms sequence-only models in predicting drug resistance.
slots.clarification_sentence: The new models better classify how the virus responds to drugs.

slots.claim_sentence: The models identified new mutations like T216M in Reverse Transcriptase.
slots.clarification_sentence: These mutations make the virus resistant to entire classes of drugs.

slots.claim_sentence: The models achieved 84% accuracy on a Stanford University public database.
slots.clarification_sentence: This high success rate was confirmed using real-world clinical data.

slots.claim_sentence: The system uses an applicability domain to show prediction reliability.
slots.clarification_sentence: This feature tells the user if a specific result is trustworthy.

The study used 300,000 data points across three major drug classes. These classes include PIs, NRTIs, and NNRTIs used in HIV therapy. The PCM approach outperforms sequence-only models in predicting drug resistance. The new models better classify how the virus responds to drugs. The models identified new mutations like T216M in Reverse Transcriptase. These mutations make the virus resistant to entire classes of drugs. The models achieved 84% accuracy on a Stanford University public database. This high success rate was confirmed using real-world clinical data. The system uses an applicability domain to show prediction reliability. This feature tells the user if a specific result is trustworthy.

slots.clarification_sentence: This immune response provides protection against S. aureus skin infection.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers used a mutant version of the bacteria lacking ClfB.

slots.claim_sentence: Dengue virus causes about 100 million symptomatic infections every year.
slots.clarification_sentence: This virus is a common infection spread by mosquitoes.

slots.claim_sentence: Infections range from mild dengue fever to severe dengue hemorrhagic fever.
slots.clarification_sentence: Dengue hemorrhagic fever is a life-threatening form of the disease.

slots.claim_sentence: Scientists used mass spectrometry to perform metabolomic profiling on adult sera.
slots.clarification_sentence: This method identifies small molecules in the blood of patients.

slots.claim_sentence: The study identified 29 metabolites that differ during the critical phase.
slots.clarification_sentence: These differences appear when comparing mild and severe dengue cases.

slots.claim_sentence: Bile acids were 5 fold higher in patients with severe dengue.
slots.clarification_sentence: High bile acids correlated with AST and ALT markers of liver injury.

slots.claim_sentence: Uric acid was 1.5 fold lower in patients with severe disease.
slots.clarification_sentence: Lower levels of this antioxidant can lead to increased oxidative stress.

slots.claim_sentence: Eight metabolites remained altered during the recovery phase of the illness.
slots.clarification_sentence: One persistent metabolite was a bile acid called chenodeoxyglycocholic acid.

slots.claim_sentence: These altered pathways provide new therapeutic targets for dengue management.
slots.clarification_sentence: The findings help explain the pathogenesis of severe dengue infections.

slots.claim_sentence: Chenodeoxyglycocholic acid was still about 3 times higher during recovery.
slots.clarification_sentence: Persistent chemical imbalances suggest a lasting impact on the liver.

slots.claim_sentence: Cells must control the abundance of substrate receptor subunits in Cullin-RING ubiquitin ligases.
slots.clarification_sentence: These ligases, known as CRLs, mark specific proteins for destruction to maintain balance.

slots.claim_sentence: Unbalanced levels of these receptors can lead to sequestration of core CRL components.
slots.clarification_sentence: This overabundant receptor buildup is linked to diseases such as cancer.

slots.claim_sentence: F-box proteins are substrate receptors typically regulated by autocatalytic ubiquitylation.
slots.clarification_sentence: This process leads to proteasome-mediated degradation to keep receptor levels low.

slots.claim_sentence: Researchers identified a new degradation pathway for the yeast F-box protein Met30.
slots.clarification_sentence: This pathway targets Met30 only when it is dissociated from the Skp1 component.

slots.claim_sentence: The new Met30 pathway requires Cdc53/Cul1 but is independent of Skp1.
slots.clarification_sentence: This finding was unexpected because Skp1 usually connects the receptor to the core.

slots.claim_sentence: This non-canonical degradation pathway is critical for maintaining chromosome stability.
slots.clarification_sentence: The pathway also helps yeast cells survive heavy metal stress from cadmium.

slots.claim_sentence: The study assigns biological functions to a sub-complex of Cdc53, Rbx1, and Cdc34.
slots.clarification_sentence: This sub-complex works to regulate the cell without needing the Skp1 protein.

slots.claim_sentence: Overabundant receptors limit competition for substrates between assembled ligases and free subunits.
slots.clarification_sentence: Maintaining a balanced repertoire of functional ligases ensures proper cellular health.
